title: Tracking: NU7 Mainnet activation readiness

type.name: Epic
type.description: A high-level goal or major feature that needs to be broken down into smaller stories.

body:
## Summary

This issue tracks the work that must be complete before Zebra 7.0.0 stable and the NU7 Mainnet activation. It groups the open sync-stall fixes, the Testnet checks that reduce risk now, and the Mainnet activation tasks under one parent, so that progress is visible in one place.

NU7 activated on public Testnet at height 4,465,026 on about 2026-10-06 (https://forum.zcashcommunity.com/t/zebra-7-0-0-rc-0-nu7-arrives-on-testnet/58006). No Mainnet activation height is published yet.

## Context (as reported)

- Since the 7.0.0-rc.0 release, operators report Testnet nodes that stop syncing (https://forum.zcashcommunity.com/t/zebra-7-0-0-rc-0-nu7-arrives-on-testnet/58006/6, https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11133#issuecomment-5975520010).
- Several sync-stall fixes exist as open pull requests with no agreed merge order or release target.
- The seeder fleet cannot confirm the NU7 activation on Testnet: its activation observer reports about 14 of 31 peer groups ready, against a 75% quorum (https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zeeder/pull/114).

## Scope

Three groups. Each row is a sub-issue of this epic.

### 1. Fix the known sync stalls

| Issue | Fix | State on 2026-10-12 |
|---|---|---|
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610 Block requests are refused while serving peers are busy | https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11515, then https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11521, https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/10910, https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11525, https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11532 | Fix of record and release target not decided |
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11133 Testnet node follows a losing branch during min-difficulty bursts | https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11582 | Review requested |
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11619 Shared outpoints are removed from the UTXO caches too early | none | No owner |
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11618 Address-book gossip batch pins a runtime worker and stalls RPC | none | No owner |
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11623 Honest peers are banned for lock-time rejections | https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11627 | Review needed |

### 2. Reduce Testnet risk now

| Issue | State on 2026-10-12 |
|---|---|
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11675 Alert when Zebra and Zakura disagree on the Testnet chain | In the NU7 milestone; tracked as a sub-issue of https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11632 (release signals), not of this epic |
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11676 7.0.0-rc.0 Testnet node stops at height 4,417,933 (possibly the same cause as https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11133) | Waiting for logs from the reporter |

### 3. Activate on Mainnet

| Issue | State on 2026-10-12 |
|---|---|
| https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/9508 Implement the NU7 deployment ZIP, with https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11446 Set the NU7 Mainnet activation height | Testnet height set; Mainnet height not published |

Three security fixes tracked in the private repository are also part of 7.0.0. They are sub-issues of this epic and count in the progress above; their details are visible only to people with access to that repository.

## Related issues / PRs

- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/9501 Tracking: NU7 ZIPs. Closed: the NU7 ZIPs are implemented. This epic covers readiness, not implementation.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/10192 Investigate sync restarts at chain tip. Background investigation; https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610 identifies one specific cause and moves under this epic.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11469 Differential test against the 25-second stressnet harness. Validation of ZIP 218 under load; related, not a sub-issue.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11482 Reject configured activation heights for upgrades without a branch ID. Small hardening; related.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11626 Release 7.0.0-rc.1. Contains three block-gossip fixes merged since rc.0 but none of the stall fixes in group 1.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zeeder/pull/114 Seeder activation observer: export probe outcomes as metrics. Gives an independent signal of NU7 activation on each network.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zinder/issues/104 Qualify a full-history NU7 Testnet source. Testnet data source for checks.

## Initial technical review (first look, unverified)

**Likely areas involved:**
- `zebra-network/src/peer_set/set.rs` (`route_inv`) and `zebrad/src/components/sync.rs` (retry limits, `BLOCK_VERIFY_TIMEOUT`): the near-tip refusal path in https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610.
- `zebra-state/src/service/non_finalized_state.rs`, `zebra-state/src/service/write.rs`, `zebra-state/src/service/queued_blocks.rs`: fork eviction and the UTXO caches in https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11133 and https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11619.
- `zebra-network/src/address_book.rs`, `zebra-network/src/address_book_updater.rs`: the gossip batch in https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11618.
- `zebra-chain/src/parameters/network_upgrade.rs` (Mainnet activation table) and `zebra-chain/src/parameters/network/testnet.rs` (`TESTNET_ACTIVATION_HEIGHTS`): the activation height in https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11446.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` and the release checklist: the 7.0.0 stable release.

**Possible approach:**
1. Decide the fix of record for https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610 and the release that carries it. The smallest non-breaking change is https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11515.
2. Review and merge https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11582 and https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11627.
3. Assign https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11619 and https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11618, and reply to the reporter of 11618.
4. Start the Testnet divergence watch and collect logs for the forum report.
5. Set the Mainnet activation height when it is published, with the two tests listed in https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11446.
6. Cut 7.0.0 stable only after the group 1 fixes selected for it are merged.

**Risks / dependencies:**
- The Mainnet activation height is decided outside this repository. Until it is published, the stable release cannot be final.
- https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11521 is a breaking change to `zebra-network`; https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11515 is not. The choice affects whether a 6.4.x patch is possible.
- The forum report at height 4,417,933 is not confirmed as https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11133; CI synced Testnet past that height from genesis on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-09.

## Open questions for engineers

- [ ] Fix of record for https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610: https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/pull/11515 alone for the next release candidate, with the rest of the stack later?
- [ ] Which group 1 fixes block 7.0.0 stable, and which can follow in a patch release?
- [ ] Does https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/4545 need to land before Mainnet activation, or is it optional for NU7?
- [ ] Which signal confirms NU7 activation on each network: the seeder activation observer, the divergence watch, or both?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every sub-issue in group 1 is closed by a merged pull request or closed with a written reason.
- [ ] The Testnet divergence watch runs and alerts the team on a tip mismatch between Zebra and Zakura.
- [ ] The Mainnet activation height is set in Zebra with the tests from https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11446, and the matching dependency releases are pinned.
- [ ] 7.0.0 stable is released with the group 1 fixes selected for it, and its release notes list them.
- [ ] Every sub-issue has one assignee and a Priority, and is in the NU7 milestone.

## Next step

The epic owner answers the open questions, starting with the fix of record for https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra/issues/11610. Pull request authors add `Part of #<sub-issue>` to their pull requests. This epic is closed by hand after 7.0.0 stable is released and Mainnet activation is confirmed.

Security/consensus note: this epic links sync-stall bugs that are already public and the NU7 activation parameters, which are consensus-critical. It adds no reproduction detail. New findings that are not yet public follow `SECURITY.md`, not this issue.
